List the punkst runs stored in a SpatialData store

Source: R/writeback.R
sdata_runs.Rd

List the punkst runs stored in a SpatialData store

Usage

sdata_runs(sdata, python = NULL, log = tempfile("runs", fileext = ".log"))

Arguments

sdata

Path to a store written by sdata_writeback().

python

Interpreter override; see punkst_setup().

log

Log file.

Value

A data frame with one row per run: run, table, n_hexagons, n_genes, n_topics, hex_size and a list column params holding the recorded tiles2hex and topic_model parameters.

Examples

# Requires a Python interpreter with spatialdata; skipped otherwise.
store <- file.path(tempdir(), "demo.zarr")
dir.create(store)
#> Warning: '/tmp/RtmpNiRhoD/demo.zarr' already exists
tryCatch(
    sdata_runs(store),
    error = function(e) message("spatialdata not available: ", conditionMessage(e)))
#> [1] run        table      n_hexagons n_genes    n_topics   hex_size   params    
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
